scientific.integrity: The motivating full text was inspected at the declared Caputo-Fabrizio model, scalar boundedness equations, Losada-Nieto integral formulation, and numerical predictor-corrector section. The Diethelm-Ford-Freed primary preprint was inspected through its operator definition, Volterra equivalence, and predictor-corrector derivation, including visual inspection of the relevant PDF pages. Supporting Caputo-Fabrizio theory was checked for the initial-time and Volterra-equation structure. The bundled checker replays the scalar CF algebra. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The finding concerns the fractional-operator consistency of the printed analysis and numerical method. It does not invalidate the integer-order next-generation calculation or claim that every boundedness conclusion is false. The figures may still represent a classical Caputo version of the compartmental model.

title: The printed Lassa-fever analysis applies Caputo formulas to a Caputo-Fabrizio model
